circuit.name: Interleaved Multiphase Buck DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Two-phase interleaved synchronous buck converter for high-current CPU/GPU core power delivery. Converts 12V input to 1.2V output at ~2.4A load. Both phases run at 500kHz with 180 degrees phase offset (tdelay = half-period = 1us on phase 2) to achieve ripple current cancellation at the output. Each phase uses PMOS high-side and NMOS synchronous low-side with 100ns dead time. Shared output capacitor benefits from interleaved ripple cancellation, achieving substantially lower ripple than a single-phase design.

requirements.requirement: Output voltage regulation at 1.2V; verify interleaved ripple cancellation achieves < 5mV ripple

data.description: Peak-to-peak output ripple (should be cancelled by interleaving)

Efficiency and per-phase loss breakdown
